'''''Cymbidium lowianum''''', called '''Low's boat orchid''', is a species of [[orchid]] in the genus ''[[Cymbidium]]'', native to Assam in India, Yunnan in China, Myanmar, Thailand, and Vietnam.<ref name="625076-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:625076-1 |title=''Cymbidium lowianum'' (Rchb.f.) Rchb.f. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=20 February 2021 }}</ref> It has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Cymbidium lowianum'' Low's boat orchid |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/105859/Cymbidium-lowianum/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=20 February 2021 }}</ref>

==Subtaxa==
The following varieties are currently accepted:<ref name="625076-1" />
*''Cymbidium lowianum'' var. ''ailaoense'' <small>X.M.Xu</small>
*''Cymbidium lowianum'' var. ''kalawense'' <small>(Colyear) Govaerts</small>
*''Cymbidium lowianum'' var. ''lowianum''
